title: Membership & Payment Behaviour
description: Institute-wide switches for how memberships renew and whether members can move between plans. Both are off by default.

renewal.hint: Runs a daily scan over this institute's member plans and applies each batch's enrollment policy: pre-expiry reminders, the post-expiry waiting period, and final expiry. Off by default — while disabled, no plan in this institute is ever processed by the scheduler.

planChange.hintOn: Members can move between the plans you've marked switchable in the payment options below. Upgrades charge the prorated difference; downgrades take effect at the end of their paid cycle.
planChange.hintOff: Members never see a “change plan” option. Turn this on to expose it, then choose which payment options and plans they may switch to.
